verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud storage product, but the evidence pack contains nothing documenting a first-party AI surface in OneDrive for asking questions of files, summarizing, or extracting content. The closest items are keyword search, thumbnails and a mention of 'analytics', which are adjacent features and not content-understanding AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced
